plan.title: Exercise: home strength circuit
plan.description:
DukaIQ weekly curriculum — September 7–13, 2026.
Warm up 5 min. Start with 1 round; add a second if comfortable. Per round: jumping jacks 15–20 (or 20 alternating step jacks), press-ups 8–10, squats 8–10, glute bridges 10, bird-dogs 5/side, small crunches 6–8. If already comfortable with sit-ups, substitute 5–8 for crunches; do not add both. Rest 30–60 sec between exercises and 90 sec between rounds. Keep about 2 good reps in reserve. Cool down 3–5 min. Stop movements causing pain. Saturday: easy walk instead if not recovered. Track rounds/reps and how you feel.
